tool_calls.arguments:
{"command":"# Define the minimum permissions required for the config reader service account
kubectl create role config-reader-role --verb=get --verb=list --resource=configmaps --namespace=default

# Bind the role to the existing config-reader service account in the default namespace
kubectl create rolebinding config-reader-rolebinding --role=config-reader-role --serviceaccount=default:config-reader

# Delete the unhealthy pod to force a restart and trigger re-execution of the init container with new permissions
kubectl delete pod app-7c79c7f647-z4z9g -n default"}
